blocks.content: The authority consists of a ten-member body comprising a chairman, five whole-time members, and four part-time members appointed by the Government of India.

items: Remember the breakdown of 10 IRDAI members: 1 Chairman + 5 Whole-time Members + 4 Part-time Members.
Different age limits apply: Maximum age limit is 65 years for the Chairman and 62 years for Whole-time Members.
All members of IRDAI are exclusively appointed by the Government of India under the provisions of the IRDAI Act, 1999.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) is a 10-member statutory body established under Section 4 of the IRDAI Act, 1999.
The authority comprises one Chairman, five whole-time members, and four part-time members, all appointed by the Central Government.
The Chairman holds office for a term of 5 years or until attaining the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.
Whole-time members hold office for a term of 5 years or until attaining the age of 62 years.
Members are selected from individuals with knowledge or experience in insurance, actuarial science, finance, law, or administration.
